QuestInfo.name: There's a Phantom on Phantom
QuestInfo.1: Take the charm to the #bShaman Rock#k in the #bHumid Swamp#k. You and the thing on your back will finally get to meet.
QuestInfo.2: A familiar, half-transparent face stares back at you intently. It's Commander #p1404005#, the man you fought hundreds of years ago!

0.0: Here, take this charm and get down to a #bShaman Rock#k before that thing gets any creepier. Good luck, and don't ever come back here again.
0.1: The nearest Shaman Rock is in the #bHumid Swamp#k. Go!

yes.0: You must have cooked up quite a grudge to have anything that mean following you around.

no.0: You are ridiculous. You are a ridiculous person.

1.0: It's nice to finally talk to you again, Phantom. How many hundreds of years has it been?

npc.0: How long are you going to wait to get to #bShaman Rock#k? Go now, and take that ugly thing with you!
